notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Hell's Caretaker.
You control at least one creature.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
Hell's Caretaker does not have summoning sickness.
description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by sacrificing a creature you control.
Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Resolve the Hell's Caretaker's ability, returning any target creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
